methodology.baseball_probability: p_replay_baseline_raw = P(WIN | no PUSH), then only calibration fitted on strictly earlier game blocks
methodology.leakage: current layered replay probabilities, final scores and future blocks are excluded from feature/calibration/market-weight generation
methodology.market_missing: rows without a recorded historical sharp probability remain usable for baseball calibration but do not count toward posterior promotion evidence
methodology.posterior: Sharp blend weight is learned from strictly earlier out-of-sample game observations on a 0..100% grid; phase-specific evidence is preferred and pooled market evidence is fallback; insufficient evidence means 0% Sharp
methodology.promotion_independence: pooled promotion uses one latest phase per unique game; EARLY/LATE/FINAL are also reported separately and never summed as independent matches
methodology.walk_forward: blocked chronological by whole game; all phases of a game remain in the same holdout block so its final result can never train another phase of the same game

promotion_sample_unit: unique game; pooled comparison keeps one latest pregame phase per game
